policy: Meaningful suffixes may verify a variant family when they agree with catalog text, but generic suffixes such as Jacket or Cape do not necessarily resolve one exact physical release. Exact artwork equivalence is never inferred automatically.

physical_candidates.catalog_name: Mace Windu, Dark Tan Plain Legs, Cape

records.reason: The Cape suffix verifies a caped Mace Windu family, but at least two pre-game physical cape releases are supported. The suffix alone cannot distinguish 2006 tan-legs from 2012 dark-tan-legs Mace.
